# ChunkVolume

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

The 67^3 density samples of a chunk that crosses the surface.

## Description

Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect when the generated chunk has both solid (> 0) and empty (<= 0) samples. chunk::num_values = 67^3 floats, layout [x][z][y] (chunk::index), sample (x, y, z) at chunk::samplePosition(pos, x, y, z) (one-sample border). Read by TerrainSys (upload for GPU meshing) and TerrainColliders (CPU colliders).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | `std::vector<float>` | empty | chunk::num_values densities, > 0 is solid |
